Selected licences and retained input boundaries

The owner's 5 October 2026 selection covers original project software under GPL-2.0-or-later and original documentation under CC BY 4.0. Included complete texts and the exact component map carry these choices forward. Human creators and contributions are not inferred from local names or AI assistance.

Pinned Linux patch context retains its upstream ISC notices. Kernel whole-work obligations remain separate; this does not relicense GPLv2-only kernel material to GPLv3. Included ISC/COPYING/GPL-2.0 notices remain byte exact. The observed module declaration is Dual BSD/GPL; that declaration does not change project contribution licences or independently resolve derivative obligations.

Manufacturer firmware/ROM, original ambient recordings and third-party build inputs receive no new project licence. A reader must independently supply the pinned MFG image, kernel source, headers and toolchain under applicable terms. No download location grants redistribution permission. The package grants no rights to excluded inputs.
